metadata.case_name: LAI WAH WAI v. CASTCO TESTING CENTRE LTD.

plaintiff.occupation_before: employee of the Defendant engaged in the preparation of concrete mix samples (cleaning and preparing moulds)

injuries.description: central and right side L5/S1 disc prolapse with compression of the right S1 nerve root
source: Subsequent examination showed that there was a central and right side L5/S1 disc prolapse with compression of the right S1 nerve root.

a operation was eventually performed on 2nd February 1993, namely the right side feneration and dissectomy of the L5/S1 level. A bulging disc was found and the dissectomy was done and the nerve root was free.
MR1 scan on 1st September 1993 revealed that there was some fibrosis over the operated site and the right S1 nerve root was slightly swollen but there was no compression.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of sacral spine

manifestations.description: low back pain with the pain radiating down to his left leg; later shifted to his right side
continued low back pain and bilateral lower limbs numbness
diminished sensitivity at the web space between the first and second toes
decreased left and right lateral flexion by 15 degrees each; decreased extension by 10 degrees; decreased flexion by 25 degrees
decreased straight left and right leg elevation by 20 degrees and 10 degrees respectively
decreased extension and flexion of the hips by 5 degrees and 35 degrees
backache on sitting, standing and walking for longer than 30 minutes; pain aggravated by walking
inability to lift heavy objects ("not even his four year old son")
unable to play football or run during weekends
slight increase in the risk of osteoarthritis of the lumbar spine

treatments_received: right side feneration and dissectomy of the L5/S1 level (operation on 1993-02-02)

losses.description: diminished sensitivity at the web space between the first and second toes; decreased ranges of motion of the lumbar spine and hips
backache on sitting, standing and walking longer than 30 minutes; pain aggravated by walking; cannot run or play football

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: unable to lift heavy objects ("not even his four year old son")
assessed loss of earning capacity of 30% and inability to return to pre-accident employment or jobs requiring heavy lifting

comparable_cases.injury_description: level of damages for the serious injuries category raised to $250,000 to $335,000
